input: What has Salesforce changed in Agentforce pricing in 2026?

output.question: What has Salesforce changed in Agentforce pricing in 2026?
output.answer: As of November 10, 2026, Salesforce has shifted Agentforce toward bundled, outcome- and consumption-based pricing rather than only the earlier per-conversation model. On September 3 it introduced Core, Advanced, and Max editions at $195, $395, and $550 per user/month; Core, Advanced, and Max include 500,000, 1 million, and 2.75 million Flex Credits per organization per year, respectively, while Max kept the Agentforce 1 price and existing Agentforce 1 customers can upgrade to Max at no extra cost. Salesforce also lists Flex Credits at $500 per 100,000 credits, Conversations at $2 each, Agentforce add-ons at $125/user/month, and Help Agent resolutions at $2 each; Help Agent uses outcome-based billing, so customers pay when an issue is resolved.

key_facts.fact: On September 3, 2026, Salesforce launched new Core, Advanced, and Max editions for Agentforce Sales, Service, and Industries, consolidating AI, Slack, analytics, security, and support into the editions.
The 2026 edition prices are $195 per user/month for Core, $395 per user/month for Advanced, and $550 per user/month for Max; Max maintained the Agentforce 1 price.
The new editions include 500,000 Flex Credits for Core, 1 million for Advanced, and 2.75 million for Max, each per organization per year.
Existing Agentforce 1 Edition customers can upgrade to Max at no extra cost, with up to $500 in added value.

Current Agentforce consumption prices are $500 per 100,000 Flex Credits and $2 per conversation; the page also lists Agentforce add-ons at $125 per user/month, the Agentforce User License at $5 per user/month plus Flex Credits, and Max from $550 per user/month.
Salesforce's current pricing page lists Help Agent Resolutions at $2, and Salesforce describes Help Agent as outcome-based pricing where customers pay when the agent resolves an issue autonomously.

passages.quote: Salesforce is launching new Core, Advanced, and Max editions for Agentforce Sales, Agentforce Service, and Agentforce Industries
Core Editions now include 500,000 Flex Credits, Advanced Editions include 1 million Flex Credits, and Max Editions include 2.75 million Flex Credits
Core Editions: $195 per user/month ... Advanced Editions: $395 per user/month ... Max Editions: $550 per user/month (zero pricing change and offering nearly 60% more value than Agentforce 1 Edition)
existing Agentforce 1 Edition customers can upgrade at no extra cost to our new Max edition, with up to $500 in added value
With pay-per-resolution pricing, you are charged when Help Agent resolves an issue autonomously, start to finish. If the customer asks for a human or walks away unhappy, there is no charge.

caveats: Salesforce says pricing and packaging are subject to change, availability may vary by region, and customer agreements govern actual pricing.

The September 2026 announcement says existing customer pricing on legacy editions remains unchanged; the new Core and Advanced prices therefore should not be assumed to apply retroactively to all customers.
The Agentforce pricing page is a current pricing page but does not display a publication date; its figures are treated as observed on 2026-11-10.
The $2 Help Agent resolution figure is on Salesforce's current pricing page, while the Help Agent announcement establishes the outcome-based billing approach.
